column1: # Two-light halts only. Aaron, 2026-09-06. TEAM RELAY -- fencers change between
# legs, so the score is the cumulative TEAM score. `Side Awarded` is who the referee
# gave the action to, i.e. who held PRIORITY -- not necessarily who scored: on a
# mixed halt an off-target hit by the priority holder annuls and nothing is awarded.
# Blank = nothing awarded (both off target). NA = referee gave no priority.
# Single-lamp halts are absent by design, so Score JUMPS and is NOT a checksum here.
